newsitem.title: USA: Bontex listed on Nasdaq National Market.
newsitem.headline: Bontex listed on Nasdaq National Market.

text.p: Bontex stock is listed on the Nasdaq National Market Issue under the symbol "BOTX", a company statement said on Thursday.

The stock, formerly listed as Gabndfibr -- an acronym for Georgia Bonded Fibers Inc -- is a global manufacturer and distributor of elastomeric wet web non-woven fiberboard products used by the footwear, headwear, luggage, leathergoods and automative industries.
